title: Equilibrium prices under hidden Markov fundamentals
abstract: arXiv:2609.21684v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study a representative-agent Epstein-Zin economy with geometric dividends and a hidden finite-state Markov drift. We allow the price-dividend ratio to contain an additional positive, absolutely continuous valuation factor and, within the class $\mathfrak C$ defined below and under the regularity, admissibility, and positivity conditions of our main theorem, equilibrium forces this factor to be constant, yielding belief-Markovian prices. In the two-state case, under the stated positivity condition and strictly positive transition intensities, we prove existence, uniqueness, endpoint smoothness, interior analyticity, and uniform bounds for the positive solution of the pricing equation. For $0<\theta\leq1$, this solution supports an equilibrium under any continuous short rate satisfying the model's one-sided portfolio condition. Finally, in the two-state subregion $\eta>0$, we derive belief-dependent stock volatility, a European option

translated_title: 隐马尔可夫基本面下的均衡价格
translated_abstract: 我们研究一个具有几何红利和隐藏有限状态马尔可夫漂移的代表性主体 Epstein-Zin 经济。我们允许价格-红利比率包含一个额外的正的、绝对连续的估值因子，并且在下文定义的类 $\mathfrak C$ 内以及在我们主要定理的正则性、可容许性和正性条件下，均衡迫使该因子为常数，从而得到信念-马尔可夫价格。在两状态情形下，在所述正性条件和严格正的转移强度下，我们证明了定价方程正解的存在性、唯一性、端点光滑性、内部解析性以及一致界。对于 $0<\theta\leq1$，该解在任何满足模型单边组合条件的连续短期利率下均支持一个均衡。最后，在两状态子区域 $\eta>0$ 中，我们推导出依赖信念的股票波动率以及欧式期权（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文在具有隐藏马尔可夫基本面的 Epstein-Zin 经济中证明了均衡会迫使价格-红利比率中的估值因子为常数，从而得到信念-马尔可夫价格，并在两状态情形下证明了定价方程正解的存在性、唯一性、光滑性与一致界等性质。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that in an Epstein-Zin economy with hidden Markov fundamentals, equilibrium forces the valuation factor in the price-dividend ratio to be constant, yielding belief-Markovian prices, and establishes existence, uniqueness, smoothness, and uniform bounds for the positive solution of the pricing equation in the two-state case.
